other_new_defects.quote: never into a directory it creates itself
other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: WC-6 forbids a no-resume command writing its contract into a directory it creates, but workflow (no resume flag, 'Fresh package each run') writes into a generated `.dev/tasks/to-do/<id>/` and adversarial into `<output>/adversarial/`, so the required rows contradict WC-6 and cannot satisfy it.

other_new_defects.quote: `--outcome failed` in every other case: the report says `failed` or `blocked`, no report exists, or it is empty, unreadable or has a missing or other `status`
other_new_defects.what_goes_wrong: Combined with AC-0.4 (L194), where P0 reports are Markdown (REPORT.md, the TDD) with no `status`, every correct P0 smoke run must send outcome failed, so step 3's 'outcome matches the report's status' cannot pass and P0 gates all later phases.
